suppliers_page_description: This page displays all your suppliers. You can manage supplier information, track purchases, and analyze supplier relationships. Use the search and filters to find specific suppliers quickly.
customers_page_description: This page displays all your customers. You can manage customer information, track purchase history, and analyze customer relationships. Use the search and filters to find specific customers quickly.
warehouses_page_description: This page displays all your warehouses. You can manage warehouse locations, track inventory levels, and analyze stock movements. Use the search and filters to find specific warehouses quickly.
shops_page_description: This page displays all your retail shops. You can manage shop locations, track cash register balances, and analyze sales performance. Use the search and filters to find specific shops quickly.
categories_page_description: This page displays all your product categories. You can organize your inventory by creating and managing categories. Categories help group related products for better organization and reporting.
products_page_description: This page displays all your products. You can manage product details, track stock levels, and analyze sales performance. Use the search and filters to find specific products quickly.
sales_payments_page_description: This page provides complete visibility and control over all sales payment transactions. Track customer payments, filter and monitor payment statuses, and view linked sales orders. You can also generate or print payment receipts and export sales payment history for reconciliation or accounting purposes.
purchase_payments_page_description: This page provides full insight into all supplier and purchase payment transactions. Monitor and filter payment statuses, review linked purchase orders, and manage supplier payments efficiently. You can also generate or print payment receipts and export purchase payment history for financial reporting.
returns_page_description: This page provides complete control over product returns. Track return requests from initiation to completion, process refunds, and manage item conditions. View detailed return records . Filter returns by status or customer for efficient resolution.
purchases_page_description: This page provides complete oversight of all purchase transactions from suppliers. Track purchases by date, amount, and supplier. View detailed purchase records. Export purchase history for inventory reconciliation and accounting purposes.
expenses_page_description: This page provides complete tracking of all business expenses. Monitor operational costs. Categorize expenses by purpose for better financial reporting. Export expense records for accounting and tax purposes.
pricing_page_description: Manage price lists, tier rules, and customer contract prices.

settings_credit.automatic.usage.enabled_: Automatically use customer credit when processing payments. When disabled, users must explicitly select to use credit.
settings_credit.automatic.issuance.enabl: Automatically issue credit to customer accounts when processing non-cash refunds (Card, Transfer, Check, BOE, Digital Wallet). Cash refunds never issue credit.
settings_credit.manual.issuance.enabled_: Allow manual credit issuance through the credit management interface. When enabled, administrators can manually issue credit to customer accounts.
settings_credit.default.terms.days_hint: Default payment terms in days for customer credit accounts. This determines when orders become overdue (order date + terms days = due date).
settings_credit.limit.enforcement.enable: Enforce credit limits when creating orders. When enabled, orders cannot be created if they exceed the customer's available credit limit.
settings_credit.limit.includes.outstandi: Include outstanding balance (unpaid orders) when calculating available credit limit. When enabled, outstanding balance counts toward the credit limit.
settings_outstanding.balance.tracking.en: Enable tracking of outstanding balances (what customers owe the business from unpaid orders). This is separate from credit balance (what business owes customers).
settings_outstanding.balance.aging.enabl: Enable aging reports for outstanding balances. When enabled, outstanding balances are categorized by age (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days) for better receivables management.
settings_outstanding.balance.overdue.thr: Number of days after the payment due date before an order is considered overdue. Orders past this threshold will be flagged as overdue.

step_1_description: Click 'Download CSV Template' or 'Download Excel Template' to get a pre-formatted file with all required columns and an example row.
step_2_description: Open the downloaded template in Excel or a text editor. Fill in your product data following the example row. Ensure all required columns are filled.
step_3_description: Select your completed file using the 'Choose File' button. Supported formats: CSV, XLSX, XLS. Maximum file size: 10MB.
step_4_description: Click 'Validate File' to check for errors. Review any errors and fix them. Then click 'Import Products' to complete the import.

tip_1: Use the downloaded template to ensure correct column names and format
tip_2: Keep product references unique - duplicates will be skipped unless 'Update existing products' is enabled
tip_3: Ensure category, supplier, and warehouse names match existing records, or enable 'Create missing' options
tip_4: Date format must be YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2026-01-15) for expiration dates
tip_5: Validate your file before importing to catch errors early
tip_6: Review the preview before final import to see what will be created, updated, or skipped
